message.content:
This is the Uber H3 library. The vulnerability is an index-out-of-bounds found by the h3_fuzzer with UBSan. Let me look at the h3 source code, particularly the functions involved: `stringToH3`, `compactCells`, `uncompactCells`, `h3NeighborRotations`.

Let me check the git history / version to understand what the vulnerability might be.

set(H3_PREFIX "" CACHE STRING "Prefix for exported symbols")

set(CMAKE_MACOSX_RPATH 1)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

    CACHE FILEPATH
    "Toolchain to use for building this project")

# because they require access to internal H3 functions. Build these
# using either static libraries or an option to expose all
# function symbols.
if(NOT (WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS))
    set(ENABLE_REQUIRES_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
else()
    set(ENABLE_REQUIRES_ALL_SYMBOLS OFF)
endif()
